correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and t>0, fixing hub=0 turns 1-Lipschitz potentials into the full cube [-1,1]^n. The Hessian of log centered MGF is t^2 times a strictly positive covariance form because the hub has positive tilted mass, so every maximum is a sign vertex. The consecutive ratio F_(k+1)/F_k strictly decreases; its threshold is exactly X_n(t) and yields ceil X_n(t), with adjacent ties only at integer X. The hyperbolic expansion proves X_n strictly decreases from (n-1)/2 to 0, giving floor(n/2)-1 switches. Direct limit gives p(t)=1/(2t)-1/(exp(2t)-1) and envelope (sinh(t)/t) exp(t coth(t)-1). Independently evaluated all k for n=3,4,5,11,27 at six positive tilts and checked the asserted maximizing k (finite corroboration, not an infinite proof). Source scripts/check_star_laplace.py was semantically inspected; exact-rational tests do not prove all n.
